integrity: A complete open 38-page 2015 same-object article was inspected at the exact-system, dissipativity, absorbing-set, and homoclinic sections, with document-wide searches for variance, moment, invariant-measure, conditional, and average terminology. A day-resolved 2015 public preprint was checked for the exact Glukhovsky–Dolzhansky normalization and Lyapunov-dimension scope. The mathematical bibliographic classification of a 2016 same-object paper was checked for MSC ownership. The accessible 2023 global-dynamics article statement and the full open 2026 article were compared for stronger or equivalent stationary-statistical coverage. The three conditional regressions, exact second-moment shell, speed defect, and zero-defect recurrence classification were reconstructed independently, and the polynomial algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not prove chaotic-attractor existence or uniqueness.
The temperature circle fixes a second-moment shell rather than the full stationary distribution.
The heightwise regression fixes only the conditional mean of the product \(xy\) given \(z\).
The historically earlier 1980 source was verified only at year resolution in the checked material; the structured date uses the earliest checked day-resolved public preprint containing the model.
The 2023 mathematical treatment was compared through its accessible article statement and searchable page rather than a complete locally extracted PDF.
A differently phrased equivalent invariant-measure observation could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Stationary temperature circle and heightwise convection calibration in the Glukhovsky–Dolzhansky flow
